Other site-page, image, and generated-HTML bodies and the exact documentation build remain metadata-only.
Documentation storage and derived-document byte identities are unresolved.
Exact VASPKIT binary/menu/help, usage agreement, platform profile, configuration, POTCAR, and accepted parent VASP evidence remain separate.

limitations: Semantic claim-set completeness remains explicitly unproven; exact full-file enumeration is not treated as claim closure.

The complete exact documentation-repository tree is path/object inventoried and two source pages are hash-verified externally; remaining bodies, heading slices, generated-site replay, binaries, private configuration, and VASP/POTCAR inputs remain external.
The deterministic scope extractor is centrally pinned but this exact run is not platform attested.
